info.title: Delta Registry — AI Crawler & Content-Signal Permission Delta Monitor
info.description: Watches any domain and reports the instant its AI-crawler permissions change: a robots.txt Allow/Disallow flip for GPTBot, ClaudeBot and 15 other tracked tokens, a Cloudflare Content-Signal flip, or llms.txt appearing/changing. Pay-per-event: billed only for what changed, with a free baseline audit.

post.summary: Watches any domain and reports the instant its AI-crawler permissions change: a robots.txt Allow/Disallow flip for GPTBot, ClaudeBot and 15 other tracked tokens, a Cloudflare Content-Signal flip, or llms.txt appearing/changing. Pay-per-event: billed only for what changed, with a free baseline audit.
post.x-sync-pattern-reason: Real observed max runtime 2.9s fits safely under GPT Actions' 45s cap — run-sync-get-dataset-items is safe to expose directly.

domains.description: Bare hostnames to monitor - no protocol, no path, no trailing slash. Example: "cloudflare.com", "openai.com". Each domain is checked at its own https://{domain}/robots.txt (and, if enabled, /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt). Mix your own domains with competitor/vendor domains freely - each gets fully independent delta state.

trackedBots.description: The robots.txt User-agent tokens whose Allow/Disallow directives are watched for changes over time. Defaults to 18 currently-documented AI-crawler tokens spanning OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Apple, Perplexity, Common Crawl, ByteDance, Amazon, Meta, Diffbot, and Cohere. Add a newly-published crawler token, or narrow this to one vendor family, by editing this list.

checkContentSignals.description: Parses any "Content-Signal: search=..., ai-input=..., ai-train=..." line found in robots.txt (Cloudflare's proposed extension to the standard, formalized as the IETF draft draft-romm-aipref-contentsignals) and tracks all three category values for change over time. Turn this off only if you exclusively care about classic robots.txt Allow/Disallow directives.

checkLlmsTxt.description: Fetches both well-known paths (llmstxt.org's proposed convention) and tracks presence/absence plus a content hash, so an added, removed, or edited llms.txt is reported as a CHANGED event. llms.txt is an informal community proposal, not a ratified standard - this Actor reports its presence and content as a signal, never as a compliance guarantee.

onlyNew.description: When true (default), a repeat run of an already-baselined domain only delivers ALLOWED, DISALLOWED, and CHANGED events - the free NO_CHANGE row is suppressed when nothing differs. A domain's first-ever check always delivers a free BASELINE_SNAPSHOT regardless of this setting, since that is the point of adding a domain to the watchlist. Set to false to also see an explicit "nothing changed" row on every run.

maxDomainsPerRun.description: Hard cap on how many domains from the list are checked (and, where applicable, charged) in a single run. Domains beyond this cap are simply checked on the next run - nothing about their state is lost or marked as seen.

concurrency.description: Caps the total number of in-flight HTTP requests across the whole run. Each domain fans out to up to three independent resource fetches (robots.txt, llms.txt, llms-full.txt), so this bounds total concurrent load across every domain being checked, not per-domain concurrency. Raise cautiously - most of the wall-clock cost of a large watchlist run is waiting on slow or unresponsive third-party domains, not this Actor's own compute.

requestTimeoutSecs.description: Aborts a single robots.txt/llms.txt/llms-full.txt request that takes longer than this, so one slow or unresponsive domain never stalls the whole run. Applies per individual attempt, not per domain overall.

maxRetries.description: Retry attempts (exponential backoff with jitter, capped at 15 seconds between attempts) before a single request is given up on as failed. Applies only to retryable outcomes (429 and 5xx responses, or a request timeout) - any other non-2xx, non-404 response is treated as final immediately and does not consume retry budget. A 404 is never a failure: it is parsed as a valid "resource absent" signal.

deltaStateName.description: Names this run's persistent delta-state store. Use a distinct name per independent schedule (for example "own-sites" versus "competitor-watchlist") so their baselines never cross-contaminate each other.

resetState.description: Wipes all remembered state for every domain under this deltaStateName before the run starts, so every domain is re-baselined from scratch on this run (delivered as free BASELINE_SNAPSHOT records, subject to onlyNew's usual free-baseline behavior).

200.description: Array of normalized records from the actor run.

fields.title: AI Crawler & Content-Signal Permission Delta Monitor record

record_id.description: The bare hostname this record describes. Identity key for delta tracking - stable across runs for the same domain.

event_id.description: sha256(record_id|event_type|status_fingerprint|content_fingerprint), deliberately excluding scraped_at, so a retried delivery of the same underlying event reproduces the identical id and can be safely deduplicated downstream.

event_type.description: BASELINE_SNAPSHOT: this domain's first-ever check (free). ALLOWED: a tracked bot's directive changed and at least one flip was permissive with no new block. DISALLOWED: a tracked bot's directive flipped to a block (highest-priority transition when both directions occur in the same run). CHANGED: a Content-Signal category or llms.txt/llms-full.txt changed with no bot-directive flip. NO_CHANGE: nothing differed since the last check (free, delivered only when onlyNew=false).

scraped_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp this domain's robots.txt/llms.txt were actually fetched.

is_new.description: True only for this domain's first-ever record (event_type=BASELINE_SNAPSHOT).

source_url.description: The domain's own robots.txt URL that was fetched to produce this record.

domain.description: The bare hostname, duplicated from record_id for convenience in table/CSV views.

bot_permissions.description: One entry per tracked bot token. Each value carries the matched directive ('allow', 'disallow', or 'not_specified' if no group in robots.txt names this token and no wildcard group applies), the matched path pattern, and which mechanism produced the match ('robots.txt' or null).

content_signals.description: Cloudflare Content-Signal category values as published in robots.txt ('search', 'ai_input', 'ai_train'), each 'yes', 'no', or null if the directive line was absent entirely. Null (all three) whenever checkContentSignals=false.

llms_txt.description: Presence, URL, content hash (sha256), and byte size of /llms.txt at fetch time. present=false and the other fields null if absent or checkLlmsTxt=false.

changed_permissions.description: Present only on ALLOWED/DISALLOWED events. Each entry names one bot token whose directive changed since the last check, with its real previous and new directive values.

changed_content_signals.description: Present only on CHANGED events caused by a Content-Signal flip. Each entry names one category ('search'/'ai_input'/'ai_train') with its real previous and new value.

llms_txt_change.description: Present only on a CHANGED event caused by llms.txt/llms-full.txt presence or content changing. Carries previous/new presence and previous/new content hash. Null otherwise.

status_fingerprint.description: sha256 over this domain's full bot_permissions map. Drives ALLOWED/DISALLOWED classification - the highest-priority delta signal.

content_fingerprint.description: sha256 over content_signals plus llms_txt/llms_full_txt presence-and-hash. Drives CHANGED classification when status_fingerprint is unchanged.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per delta event, most recent first.
